lines.bal: Wai sanja, Kadek lan timpalne majalan ka pasih.
lines.en: In the evening, Kadek and his friend walk to the beach.

lines.bal: Matan ai ring kauh, langit barak.
lines.en: The sun is in the west; the sky is red.

lines.bal: Angin dingin gati, nanging ia liang.
lines.en: The wind is very cold, but he is happy.

lines.bal: Ia lan timpalne negak di bias.
lines.en: He and his friend sit on the sand.

lines.bal: Ada jukung liu ring segara.
lines.en: There are many boats on the sea.

lines.bal: Kadek luwe, ia meli be pasih lan nasi.
lines.en: Kadek is hungry; he buys sea fish and rice.

lines.bal: Regane mudah, dadine ia liang gati.
lines.en: The price is cheap, so he is very happy.

lines.bal: Sesampun madaar, ia majalan mulih.
lines.en: After eating, he walks home.

lines.bal: Wengi, Kadek pules; ia kenyel nanging liang.
lines.en: At night, Kadek sleeps; he is tired but happy.

questions.prompt: Where do Kadek and his friend go?
Why is Kadek very happy about the food?
How does Kadek feel at night?

lines.bal: Jani rahina odalan ring desa icang.
lines.en: Today is the odalan day in my village.

lines.bal: Krama ngayah saking semeng, ngae penjor lan banten.
lines.en: The people serve from morning, making penjor and offerings.

lines.bal: Pemangku muspa ring ajeng, dadong negak ring pungkur.
lines.en: The priest prays at the front; grandmother sits at the back.

lines.bal: Krama ngigel ring bale banjar.
lines.en: The people dance at the banjar pavilion.

lines.bal: Dibi tiang suba taen mabalih ngigel kene.
lines.en: Yesterday I already watched dancing like this.

lines.bal: Jani tiang mabalih ajak timpal — liang gati!
lines.en: Now I watch with my friend — so fun!

lines.bal: Sesampun upacara, krama ngajeng prasad sareng-sareng.
lines.en: After the ceremony, the people eat blessed food together.

lines.bal: Upacara puput wengi, krama mantuk.
lines.en: The ceremony finishes at night; the people go home.

lines.bal: Tiang liang sawireh taen ningal odalan kene.
lines.en: I am happy because I got to see an odalan like this.

questions.prompt: What is happening in the village today?
Where does grandmother sit during the prayers?
What do the people do after the ceremony?

lines.bal: Dibi semeng, Wayan bangun, nanging cicingne nenten wénten.
lines.en: Yesterday morning, Wayan woke up, but his dog was not there.

lines.bal: Ia jejeh gati, cicingne ilang!
lines.en: He was very scared — his dog was lost!

lines.bal: Ia takon ring pisagane: cai ningal cicing icang?
lines.en: He asked his neighbor: did you see my dog?

lines.bal: Pisagane nenten uning; ia nenten ningal cicing nika.
lines.en: His neighbor didn't know; he hadn't seen the dog.

lines.bal: Wayan ngalih ring pasar, ring alas, ring tukad — nenten tepuk.
lines.en: Wayan searched the market, the forest, the river — not found.

lines.bal: Ia sebet, nanging ia terus ngalih.
lines.en: He was sad, but he kept searching.

lines.bal: Sanja, ia ningeh cicingne di duri umah.
lines.en: In the evening, he heard his dog behind the house.

lines.bal: Cicingne negak di duri bale — ia pules!
lines.en: The dog was sitting behind the pavilion — it had been sleeping!

lines.bal: Wayan liang gati, cicingne suba mewali.
lines.en: Wayan was so happy — his dog had returned.

lines.bal: Jani ia uning: cicingne demen pules di duri bale.
lines.en: Now he knows: his dog loves sleeping behind the pavilion.

questions.prompt: When does Wayan notice the dog is gone?
Where does he finally find the dog?
How does Wayan feel at the end?

lines.bal: Benjang Galungan, krama desa sibuk gati.
lines.en: Tomorrow is Galungan; the villagers are very busy.

lines.bal: Bapa ngae penjor di ajeng jero, lan meme ngae banten.
lines.en: Father makes a penjor in front of the house, and mother makes offerings.

lines.bal: Panak panak maen di natah.
lines.en: The children play in the courtyard.

lines.bal: Wengi, krama mebakti ring pura.
lines.en: At night, the people pray at the temple.

lines.bal: Pemangku ngicen tirta ring krama.
lines.en: The priest gives holy water to the people.

lines.bal: Sesampun mebakti, krama ngajeng sareng-sareng.
lines.en: After praying, the people eat together.

lines.bal: Galungan nika rahina agung, dumogi jagat rahayu.
lines.en: Galungan is a great day — may the world be blessed.

lines.bal: Krama liang, desa kedas lan asri.
lines.en: The people are joyful; the village is clean and lush.

questions.prompt: What does father make in front of the house?
What do the people do at night?

lines.bal: Ada kone raksasa kaon ring alas kaja.
lines.en: Once upon a time, there was an evil giant in the northern forest.

lines.bal: Raksasa nika kuat gati, krama desa jejeh.
lines.en: The giant was very strong; the villagers were afraid.

lines.bal: Kocap, ada pahlawan alit ring desa nika.
lines.en: It is said there was a small hero in that village.

lines.bal: Pahlawan nika alit, nanging kendel.
lines.en: The hero was small, but brave.

lines.bal: Ia uning kesaktian kuna saking dadongne.
lines.en: He knew ancient magic from his grandmother.

lines.bal: Ilu, ia majalan ka alas, ngalih raksasa nika.
lines.en: In the old days, he walked to the forest, seeking the giant.

lines.bal: Raksasa suryak: nyen cai, cai alit gati!
lines.en: The giant shouted: who are you, you are so small!

lines.bal: Pahlawan nika nenten jejeh, ia maosang mantra kuna.
lines.en: The hero was not afraid; he spoke an ancient mantra.

lines.bal: Kaget, raksasa nika kalah, lantas ia malaib, nenten mewali.
lines.en: Suddenly, the giant was defeated and ran away, never returning.

lines.bal: Krama desa liang gati. Suba keto, desa nika damai.
lines.en: The villagers were so happy. After that, the village was peaceful.

lines.bal: Kocap, pahlawan nika dadi kelian desa.
lines.en: They say the hero became the village head.

questions.prompt: How does the hero defeat the giant?

lines.bal: Ada tamiu anyar ring desa, adanne Budi saking Jawa.
lines.en: There is a new guest in the village — his name is Budi, from Java.

lines.bal: Ia melali ring Bali ajak timpalne.
lines.en: He travels in Bali with his friend.

lines.bal: Ia nongos ring hotel nampek ring pasih.
lines.en: He stays at a hotel near the beach.

lines.bal: Semeng-semeng ia langi di segara.
lines.en: Every morning he swims in the sea.

lines.bal: Sanja, ia mabalih igel Bali ring panggung.
lines.en: In the evening, he watches Balinese dance on a stage.

lines.bal: Ia mefoto liu, lantas ngirim foto ka keluargane.
lines.en: He takes many photos, then sends them to his family.

lines.bal: Ia ngomong Basa Bali nika meweh, nanging ia demen malajah.
lines.en: He says Balinese is hard, but he loves learning.

lines.bal: Dibi ia meli oleh-oleh: wastra lan ukiran.
lines.en: Yesterday he bought souvenirs: cloth and carvings.

lines.bal: Regane nenten mahal, dadine ia liang.
lines.en: The prices were not expensive, so he is happy.

lines.bal: Benjang ia lakar mulih ka Jawa, nanging ia lakar mewali buin mani.
lines.en: Tomorrow he goes home to Java, but he will come back again.

options: At a hotel near the beach
